name: Share new blog articles on social media from RSS with Rizamo

parameters.content:
## Share new blog articles on social media from RSS

### How it works
For blogs and newsletters that want each new article on their social accounts without copying it by hand. When the RSS feed has a new article, the workflow reads the article's page to find its cover image (the og:image tag, or else the feed's own image) and writes a post with the title, a short summary and the link.

The post goes to a Rizamo profile's queue, so Rizamo publishes it at the profile's next free posting time and several articles on one day are spread out. An article with an image goes to every account you pick, Instagram included. One without an image goes only to accounts that take text alone, such as Facebook and Threads. A page that cannot be read still gets a post, from the feed alone.

### Setup
1. Install the verified community node `@rizamohq/n8n-nodes-rizamo` (tested with 0.1.1): open the nodes panel, search **Rizamo** and choose **Install** ([installation guide](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/verified-install/)).
2. In Rizamo, open **Developers**, create an API key and add it in n8n as a **Rizamo API** credential.
3. Put your feed's address in **New article**. It checks the feed every hour.
4. In **Queue with the image** and **Queue as text**, pick the profile and its accounts. The profile's posting times are set in Rizamo.
5. Activate the workflow.

### Customization
Edit **Write the post** to add hashtags or change the summary's length, or set **When** to Publish Now to skip the queue.

## Read the new article
Fetch each new article's page to find the image it shares.

## Write the post
Title, a 200-character summary and the link, with the page's image when it has one.

## Add it to the queue
With an image, every account you pick. Without one, text accounts such as Facebook and Threads.
